integrity: Exact rational coefficient certificate and standalone verifier included. The result is restricted to a natural parameter family and does not follow from PGF order alone.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three positive-probability coupon types and the second collector; no assertion for more types or higher sibling indices. The strongest radial-transform reference could be read only at abstract level; independent validation not undertaken.
title: The uniform law uniquely maximizes three-type sibling coupon-deficit variance
